 _**Editor 's Note**_: _Last month, we announced a**Zeteo Town Hall** with
**Francesca Albanese** that we had to reschedule due to unforeseen
circumstances. We're sorry for any inconvenience the postponement caused. But,
as promised, the online live event for **Zeteo** paid subscribers is finally
here - register below! **\- Mehdi**_

* * *

As the genocide in Gaza continues, Donald Trump wants to send Israel tens of
thousands of 2,000-pound bombs as part of a whopping [$2.8 billion weapons
deal](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/09/15/trump-
preparing-send-massive-shipment-2000-pound-bombs-israel/), while also working
to [dismantle](https://www.wsj.com/politics/policy/trump-administration-
prepares-to-sanction-the-international-criminal-court-85f5f44c) the
International Criminal Court - an act of retribution for its decision to issue
an arrest warrant against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Meanwhile, B'Tselem recently
[released](https://www.btselem.org/press_releases/20260914_the_elimination_project)
what it called the most comprehensive report of Israeli violence in the West
Bank, which concluded that Israel is "carrying out an elimination project"
there, as settler violence hits an "[all-time
high](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/07/1168045)," according to the UN.

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/today-4pm-et-francesca-albanese-

Who better to speak to about Israel's ongoing genocide and what she calls the
"[pogroms](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/25/israel-arrests-dozens-of-
palestinians-in-west-bank-amid-settler-attacks)" in the West Bank other
than**Francesca Albanese** , the UN Special Rapporteur on the situation of
human rights in the Occupied Palestinian Territories.

Albanese, who has faced severe criticism by Israel and is considered one of
the most provocative people in the world, joins **Mehdi** for a special live
**Zeteo** town hall **today, Monday,** at **4pm ET (1pm PT / 9pm BST)** you
won't want to miss!

Attendees will be limited to **paid Zeteo subscribers** , who will have the
chance to ask Albanese their own questions as well.
